turns.utterance: Replace the worn gripper fingers, both fingers per pocket.

ground_truth.node_text: Measure the diameter of each locating pin at the shank and at the nose using a calibrated digital micrometer. turns.utterance: Command ten consecutive automatic tool changes using two adjacent pockets, cycling T1 to T2 and back. Observe each change for smooth arm swing, positive tool seating in the spindle, and absence of toolholder drop or misalignment.

ground_truth.node_text: Command ten consecutive automatic tool changes using two adjacent pockets, cycling T1 to T2 and back. Observe each change for smooth arm swing, positive tool seating in the spindle, and absence of toolholder drop or misalignment.
